sanskrit_verse:
न मण्डलमतिक्रामेन्नाप्यर्वाक् पादयेत् पदम् ।
न च पातयेताप्राप्तः यावद्भूमिर्प्रकल्पिता ॥
transliteration: na maṇḍalam atikrāmen nāpy arvāk pādayet padam | na ca pātayetāprāptaḥ yāvadbhūmir prakalpitā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One shall neither transgress the boundaries of a kingdom nor step beyond the limits set by dharma; nor shall one cast down another who has not arrived at the full extent of their destined domain.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is bounded by spatial and dharmic jurisdiction
Causation arises through violation of rightful place
Capacity-based responsibility requires honoring developmental thresholds
Restoration logic demands preservation of evolutionary progression
Consciousness alignment necessitates respect for individual sovereignty
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity A crosses territorial boundary B without lawful invocation THEN halt action and restore position prior to transgression
IF entity A impedes entity B's progress before B reaches destined domain THEN reverse obstruction and enforce non-interference protocol
IF entity demonstrates incapacity to uphold jurisdictional sanctity THEN initiate capacity-building restoration sequence
IF entity violates sequential unfoldment of another’s path THEN activate integrity-realignment mechanism
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this verse establishes that sovereign domains—whether physical, functional, or evolutionary—are inviolable. Legal responsibility begins where interference ends. The threshold of judicial engagement activates upon breach of rightful placement or premature interruption of another’s unfolding capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that imbalance originates in misplacement and untimely intervention. Anupūrvaśaḥ affirms each being’s right to traverse their destined path unimpeded. Responsibility aligns with causality: whoever disrupts rightful order assumes completion duty. Retribution dissolves as truth restores natural flow.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Boundary Re-establishment Protocol – Return all entities to pre-violation positional integrity
Sequential Pathway Clearance – Remove obstacles blocking destined unfoldment
Jurisdictional Awareness Induction – Reinforce understanding of lawful scope and limitation
Evolutionary Continuity Restoration – Support uninterrupted development trajectory of affected party
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Violations dissolved through conscious realignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
